notes.title: The ultimate secret 🔎
notes.content:
Thanks to the amazing feedback we received, and the unstoppable curiosity of players, we’ve added some very interesting [b]new secret content[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44115894/55ffc81a3d6ad81f75cec94251a4a9ddc830abae.png[/img]

[h1]New runes 📖[/h1]
Ever wondered what those strange [i]symbols [/i]meant?
Well, now they’re readable… if you know how to translate them. There might be something hidden in the game to help you out. Or, if you're brave (and stubborn), you could try brute-forcing it.

[h1]What's the secret ending? 👀[/h1]
It wouldn’t be much of a secret if we just told you, would it?
But maybe… that [i]thing[/i] you unlock after doing that [i]thing[/i] is more important than it first seemed. [b]Maybe take another look?[/b] If none of this makes sense yet, don’t worry. It might soon.

[h1]Other stuff 📦[/h1]
[olist]
[*] A [b]brand-new achievement[/b] has been added on Steam 🏆
[*] If you own the OST, you might notice a [b]new track[/b] in your collection 🎵
[*] And of course, we squashed a few classic bugs and glitches 🐛🔨
[/olist]

notes.title: Minor fixes 🔧
notes.content:
[b]We cannot thank you enough![/b] The game has just been released and we've already received so many positive comments!

And here we are, the first patch [b]fixing some minor bugs[/b] based on your feedback!

[b][h1]Bug Fixes 🔨[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Out of bounds collisions updated
[*] Moon puzzle physics improved
[*] Enabled keyboard while controller connected
[*] Visual and audio glitches solved
[/list]

notes.title: The game is out! 🔥
notes.content:
[p][h1][b]Released! 🥳[/b][/h1]
After five long years of development, The Warrior is now live on Steam!
We’d like to thank everyone who supported the game, and we hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it!
